requirements.statement: Map OAuth flow findings to RFC 9700 and the declared client/authorization-server context.
requirements.evidence: Flow, client type, and threat-mitigation mapping.

requirements.statement: Do not transfer an OAuth security claim to OIDC claims or provider administration without separate authority.
requirements.evidence: Narrow scope and sibling routing record.

applicability_rule: Applicability is evaluated from external jurisdiction/entity/activity/data/version/effective-date evidence; this file never stores project facts.
exception_rule: Exceptions require an external primary-source or authority-corpus reference and remain requirement-level mappings.
